key_points: Netflix acquires Radford Studio Center for $380M, its first owned LA studio lot
Strategic vertical integration for production control and long-term cost efficiency
Stock down 37% YTD and 56% from summer 2025 peak, sparking valuation debates
Deal size is small relative to NFLX market cap (~$200B+), not financially material near-term
Positive long-term signal for content supply chain ownership
